messages:
Alex: FYI — scheduled change window in 1h (22:00 UTC). We need final vetoes, hotpatch approvals, and verification owners.
Priya: No veto from me. Hotpatch request #342 needs a quick sign-off — small env var fix.
Marta: Are release notes uploaded? I can post to docs if someone confirms the changelog snippet.
Alex: Release notes are drafted in the PR. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/changes/342
Deploy Bot: Canary job started for v3.2.1 in eu-west-1. smoke_tests: running.
Theo: Rolling pin strategy: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full over 25m. Rollback trigger: >=3% error rate sustained 2m or surge in latency >150ms p50.
Priya: Approving hotpatch #342. @Alex you good with quick pin to avoid drift?
Alex: Yes — pin for hotpatch and set canary threshold lower while we validate.
Oncall SRE: I will monitor latency slices. If we hit the threshold I'll initiate rollback per playbook.
Marta: Changelog snippet ok: "fix(env): prevent missing KMS region fallback" — I'll publish once pin is confirmed.
Deploy Bot: /pin v3.2.1-hotpatch-342 applied by Alex. Canary at 1 replica. smoke_tests: pass ✅
Theo: Quick reminder of rollback commands if needed:
```
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy rollback v3.2.0
# unpin hotpatch
/deploy unpin v3.2.1-hotpatch-342
```
Priya: Thanks. Who's on post-deploy verification for embeddings route? I can do synthetics run and snapshots.
Alex: Priya please run embeddings synthetic and validate token counts against baseline. Marta will confirm client-facing docs. Theo will watch rollout metrics. Oncall SRE will be primary for any rollback.
Deploy Bot: Canary -> 10% traffic shift completed. metrics: errors 0.05% | p50 latency +8ms | cost delta +0.2%
Priya: Synthetic results: embeddings throughput unchanged, sample vectors within expected norm. ✅
Marta: Docs posted: https://docs.internal/release-notes/v3.2.1-hotpatch-342.md :thumbsup:
Alex: Good. No objections filed in the hour window. Proceed with gradual rollout. If anyone spots issues, post in this thread and escalate immediately.
Oncall SRE: Monitoring hooks are active. I have escalation contacts listed.
Theo: Rolling to 50% now. Keep an eye on latency heatmap.
Deploy Bot: 50% rollout complete. metrics: errors 0.07% | p50 latency +11ms | no error spikes
Priya: Spot-checked customer inbox flow — looks normal.
Alex: Full rollout in 10m if metrics hold. Final check: any outstanding release notes changes?
Marta: None. All good from docs side.
Deploy Bot: Full rollout complete. final_state: success. post-deploy smoke: pass.
Alex: Thanks team — closing the window. I'll file the postmortem template with the rollout metrics and a note to evaluate the pin/unpin workflow for faster hotpatches next cycle. :wave:
